hero.title: Celebrating Happiness, Achievements & Togetherness
hero.description: The Gram Panchayat celebrates the special moments, achievements and milestones of every member of our village community.

intro.title: Every Special Moment Deserves to Be Celebrated
intro.description: Our village is more than a place where we live. It is a family where every achievement, celebration and happy moment brings us closer together.
intro.descriptionTwo: Through wishes and congratulations, the Gram Panchayat recognizes the efforts, dedication and success of villagers and encourages everyone to move forward.
intro.highlightDescription: We believe that sharing happiness makes our community stronger and creates lasting bonds among villagers.

wishes.title: Wishes & Congratulations
wishes.description: We are happy to celebrate life's beautiful moments and recognize the achievements of our villagers.

birthday.title: Birthday Wishes
birthday.description: Warm birthday wishes to all villagers. May every year bring happiness, good health and new opportunities.

anniversary.title: Anniversary Wishes
anniversary.description: Heartfelt wishes to couples celebrating their wedding anniversaries. May their journey together remain filled with love and happiness.

achievement.title: Achievement Recognition
achievement.description: Congratulations to individuals who achieve success in education, sports, public service and other fields.

success.title: Success & Milestones
success.description: We appreciate every milestone and success that inspires others and brings pride to our village.

students.title: 🎉 Felicitation Ceremony for Meritorious Students 🎉
students.subtitle: Heartiest congratulations to the successful students of the academic year 2024–25!

vijay.name: Master Vijay Pawar
vijay.achievement: Gold Medal in the State-Level Running Competition

students.message: The success achieved by the students of our village is a matter of pride for all of us. The Gram Panchayat and all villagers extend their heartfelt best wishes for their bright future and continued success!
students.signature: – Sarpanch and Gram Panchayat Members, [Village Name]

celebrations.title: Celebrating Together
celebrations.description: Festivals, community gatherings and special occasions bring villagers together and strengthen our bonds.

festivals.title: Festival Celebrations
festivals.description: We celebrate festivals with joy, unity and enthusiasm, respecting our traditions and cultural values.

community.title: Community Gatherings
community.description: Village gatherings and community events provide opportunities to connect, share happiness and build stronger relationships.

special.title: Special Occasions
special.description: We recognize important moments and memorable achievements that bring happiness and pride to our village.

values.title: Values That Bring Us Together
values.description: Our celebrations are guided by values that encourage respect, unity and positive growth throughout the village.

respect.title: Respect for Everyone
respect.description: We value every individual and appreciate their contributions, efforts and achievements.

togetherness.title: Unity & Togetherness
togetherness.description: We believe in standing together, sharing happiness and supporting one another in every situation.

encouragement.title: Encouraging Success
encouragement.description: We motivate children, youth and every villager to work towards their goals and achieve their dreams.

closing.title: Every Achievement Makes Our Village Proud
closing.description: Let us continue to celebrate happiness, appreciate achievements and build a stronger, united and progressive village together.
